START/END operator clients poll this path after 202; 200 lookup success is not task COMMITTED.

post.summary: Request cancellation of an eligible uncommitted task
post.description: ServiceBearer may cancel its own authorized control/governance tasks within its product, or eligible tasks under explicit operational management permission; it grants no general access to other players private turns. ClientSessionBearer is limited to its authorized subject/instance and allowed actions. Invisible tasks return 404, visible but forbidden tasks 403. A committed world control, approved turn or effective governance tombstone cannot be rolled back by cancellation; return 409 ALREADY_COMMITTED. Already-effective deletion cleanup is not cancelled through this route. External attempt cancellation and cost remain independently reported.
